title: Rulers of the childless land: A response to the AGMAI
author: Vladimir Lazić

metaphors.title: Occupation and collaborators
metaphors.paraphrase: Advisors helping a company eat us slower; Cassandra's fate; pulling up the ladder to rule a land with no children.

metaphors.title: Tailor and sewing machine
metaphors.paraphrase: Refusing AI like a tailor refusing a sewing machine; rebutted with Japanese artisan jeans.
